The requirement summary specifies that when initializing a [`MultiplePiePlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_b_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java) with a dataset, the plot must register itself as a change listener with the provided dataset.

### Root Cause
In [`MultiplePiePlot(CategoryDataset dataset)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_b_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L143-L158), the dataset was directly assigned via `this.dataset = dataset;` rather than calling `setDataset(dataset);`. As a result, change listener registration (`dataset.addChangeListener(this)`) and group configuration were omitted during constructor initialization.

### Fix
In [`source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_b_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/MultiplePiePlot.java#L145), replaced `this.dataset = dataset;` with `setDataset(dataset);`.

### Verification
Ran the target test `org.jfree.chart.plot.junit.MultiplePiePlotTests::testConstructor`, which now passes:
```

Running ant (run.dev.tests)................................................ OK
Failing tests: 0
```

The patch file has been saved to [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_12_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
